techStack: Test framework: Vitest 3.2.4 (not Jest); globals enabled — no need to import describe/it/expect/vi
Test environment: jsdom 26 via vitest config (environment: 'jsdom')
@testing-library/user-event v14 — must use userEvent.setup() pattern, not legacy direct calls
TypeScript: verbatimModuleSyntax=true (type-only imports need 'import type'); noUnusedLocals=true; jsx=react-jsx (no manual React import needed)
setupFiles: './tests/setup.ts' — global beforeEach stubs fetch, afterEach calls vi.unstubAllGlobals()
Coverage scoped to src/utils/productFilters.ts only — tests drive it implicitly via App
features: Search input: id='search', label text 'Search' — query with getByLabelText('Search')
Category select: id='category', label text 'Category' — query with getByLabelText('Category')
In-stock checkbox: id='inStockOnly', label text 'In-stock only' — query with getByLabelText('In-stock only')
Sort select: id='sortBy', label text 'Sort by' — query with getByLabelText('Sort by'); options: default, price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc
Clear filters button: plain text 'Clear filters' — getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filters' })
Prev/Next buttons: plain text 'Prev'/'Next'; disabled when page<=1 / page>=totalPages respectively
Spinner: <div aria-label='loading'> — getByLabelText('loading'); shown while isLoading=true

Error:

{error}

— findByRole('alert'); shown after fetch rejection

No-results:

No products found.

— when filtered result set is empty
results-count: data-testid='results-count'; exact format: 'Showing {n} products (page {page} of {totalPages})'; always plural 'products'
Product cards: <article data-testid='product-{id}'> with <h3> containing product name

15 products in API order: id1 Wireless Mouse, id2 USB-C Hub, id3 Mechanical Keyboard, id4 Webcam HD, id5 Noise-Cancelling Headphones, id6 Yoga Mat, id7 Resistance Bands, id8 Foam Roller, id9 Dumbbell Set, id10 Jump Rope, id11 Laptop Stand, id12 Desk Lamp, id13 Cable Organiser, id14 Monitor Riser, id15 Ergonomic Wrist Rest
Out-of-stock: id2 USB-C Hub, id5 Noise-Cancelling Headphones, id9 Dumbbell Set, id12 Desk Lamp (4 products → 11 in-stock)

Price ascending (by raw price field): Jump Rope $15, Cable Organiser $18, Foam Roller $22, Wireless Mouse $25, Resistance Bands $30, Monitor Riser $38, Yoga Mat $40, Desk Lamp $45, Laptop Stand $55, USB-C Hub $60, Webcam HD $79, Dumbbell Set $85, Mechanical Keyboard $95, Noise-Cancelling Headphones $149 (13 unique prices; Ergonomic Wrist Rest $28 fits between Wireless Mouse and Resistance Bands)

Price ascending full order: Jump Rope, Cable Organiser, Foam Roller, Wireless Mouse, Ergonomic Wrist Rest, Resistance Bands, Monitor Riser, Yoga Mat, Desk Lamp, Laptop Stand, USB-C Hub, Webcam HD, Dumbbell Set, Mechanical Keyboard, Noise-Cancelling Headphones
Rating descending: Yoga Mat 4.8 first, Mechanical Keyboard 4.7 second
Electronics: Wireless Mouse, USB-C Hub, Mechanical Keyboard, Webcam HD, Noise-Cancelling Headphones (5 products; 3 in-stock)
architecture: Tests live at tests/ (sibling of src/); App imported as '../src/App'
Default fetch mock (setup.ts beforeEach): { ok: true, json: async () => ({ data: [...products], total: 15, page: 1, limit: 15, totalPages: 1 }) }
Global beforeEach/afterEach in setup.ts only — individual test files add no setup hooks of their own
All stubs already import: render, screen from @testing-library/react; App from ../src/App
filtering/sorting/clearFilters/pagination stubs also import userEvent from @testing-library/user-event
Fetch is re-triggered by useEffect on [page] — changing filters does NOT re-fetch; sorting/filtering is client-side via useMemo
Pagination override pattern: vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({...})) inside individual test to override the global stub for that test
userEvent v14 pattern: const user = userEvent.setup(); then await user.type(...) / await user.click(...) / await user.selectOptions(...)
Async load pattern: render(<App />), then await screen.findByTestId('results-count') before any filter assertions
edgeCases: Loading state is synchronous — immediately after render, before any await, spinner is present and results-count is absent
After fetch resolves (microtask), must use findBy* or waitFor to assert loaded content
Search is case-insensitive (toLowerCase on both sides) and substring-match; also trims whitespace
results-count uses 'products' even for count of 1 or 0 — 'Showing 1 products (page 1 of 1)' is intentional and correct per requirements
Clear filters does NOT reset page — only resets filter state; page counter persists
Pagination re-fetches on page change (useEffect on [page]); override fetch mock in pagination test 17 to return totalPages: 3
After clicking Next (page 2), await results-count to show 'page 2' before asserting button states
Both Prev and Next are disabled when totalPages=1 (default mock scenario)
loadingError tests must override fetch via vi.stubGlobal inside the test itself (overrides the global beforeEach stub for that test only)
Pending-forever fetch: vi.fn(() => new Promise(() => {})) — render and immediately assert spinner without any await
Rejected fetch: mockRejectedValue(new Error('Network error')) — await findByRole('alert'), assert textContent is 'Network error', assert spinner gone
verbatimModuleSyntax=true: avoid unused imports; type-only imports must use 'import type'
